shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular markers at boundaries of marked spans or plotted branches. Compare the marker at 0.5 on the number line in the left image with the marker at (5, −5) in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The interval excludes the lower boundary 0.5. Right image: The right endpoint (5, −5) is included in the graph of h.
Rationales: The selected left cue excludes the indicated boundary point. The selected right cue includes the indicated boundary point, so the two constraints differ in how they admit values.
